findings.rationale: Folded: the dependency table is rewritten as the single source and absorbs every G1 fold (W1de merged row, W2a/W2b/W2e m/g splits, W2g, deps, interim displays).
Folded: W1f no longer touches runs-watch.js or elapsed; elapsed moved to W3a which depends on W1a and W1de.
Folded: W1b writes only identity and receipt pointers; status task recomputes every verdict fact; forged verdict fields must not change the verdict (negative control).
Folded: W1b names every trigger; any trigger needing a skill step is classified guidance.
Folded: W2b and W2e split into -m (mechanism) and -g (guidance, eval) rows.
Folded: W4 gate defines a true value per cell as text re-derivable from the same-instant source files by a script; pending-guidance cells pass on 來源未接; forced triggers listed.
Folded: UserPromptSubmit checks writer.pid with kill -0 first and spawns flock only when the writer is gone; hook count and p95 budget recorded against the P2 baseline.
Folded: opt-in conditions named (project config file, marker, knob=1; non-git does nothing); liveness window = idle window over tasks/attention updated_at.
Folded: W1de row states the spike-verified events; consumers of an absent tasks file (band, planned, elapsed) fall back to marker/started_at or 來源未接 with the env hint.
Folded: campaign elapsed anchor uses W1a in-file binding (earliest bound receipt), not the directory name.
Folded: W4 lands the mechanism rows and W3a only; guidance rows land later as PATCH after eval.
Folded: W2c interim pane shows 工頭狀態：來源未接; W3b shows no unseen count until built.
Folded: W2f becomes a writer: probe whether hook-visible transcript usage yields context %, write the context file when the host status line does not; else 來源未接 with the hint.
